## Ingredients

- 2 3/4 cups flour
- 1 teas. salt 
- 1 teas. baking soda
- 1 teas. vanilla
- 15 tablespoons butter (1 7/8 sticks)
- 3/4 cup brown sugar
- 3/4 cup white granulated sugar
- 2 eggs
- chocolate chips

## Directions

- mix the dry and wet stuff separately
- bake 375 F 9-11 min (or til brown around edges)
